name: Ghirapur
description: Ghirapur is the largest city on Kaladesh, a bustling inventors' city that hosts the Inventors' Fair.

summary.text: Ghirapur is the largest city on Kaladesh, a bustling inventors' city that hosts the Inventors' Fair.

bio.text: The city includes districts such as Weldfast, and the Spire overlooks it, while the Hub is called its beating heart.
Huatli arrived in the city, where Saheeli named both the plane Kaladesh and the city Ghirapur.
Years later Ishikari faced an invasion of Ghirapur, and the city's defenses later opened fire at a dragon.

status.text: The latest event shows the city's defenses opening fire at a dragon during the Aetherdrift race, where the city hosts the finish line.

timeline.summary: Fair automatons hawk attractions at Rashmi and Mitul and block their way to the market.
timeline.quote: Welcome to the Inventors' Fair!

timeline.summary: Every shop in Ghirapur turns out to be out of the needed filament.
timeline.quote: It seemed that there wasn't a WP series filament in all of Ghirapur.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken, Rashmi tells Mitul they must close the inquirium and walks away.
timeline.quote: Mitul, we're going to have to close down the inquirium.

timeline.summary: Saheeli spends the night in automaton duels with the renegades at the arena.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had been automaton dueling with the renegades all through the night.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reasons she has a responsibility as a planeswalker who knows about the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: She had a responsibility being a Planeswalker, knowing what she knew about the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Saheeli wins her twenty-fifth duel of the night.
timeline.quote: Which puts her at a perfect twenty-five for the night!

timeline.summary: Signing a young fan's autograph book, Saheeli reads her own quote about innovation without bounds and is shaken.
timeline.quote: Well, isn't that something to have shoved in your face?

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she bought Padeem's audience with a front-row duel seat.
timeline.quote: A front-row seat at the underground artificer duel next month.

timeline.summary: Rashmi learns that Padeem was once an underground quicksmith.
timeline.quote: The best of her time,

timeline.summary: Saheeli apologizes and she and Rashmi reconcile.
timeline.quote: Rashmi drew Saheeli into an embrace.

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul present the transporter to Padeem, who tells Rashmi to impress her.
timeline.quote: All right, Inventor Rashmi, impress me.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks back to Kaladesh for the first time since she left.
timeline.quote: Before she could take a deep, soothing breath, though, she had arrived.

timeline.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
timeline.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

timeline.summary: Liliana appears on the balcony next to Chandra, having followed her.
timeline.quote: Standing on the formerly unoccupied balcony next to her was Liliana

timeline.summary: A gray-haired hooded man sneaks through Ghirapur toward the Inventors' Fair, avoiding patrols.
timeline.quote: A gray-haired man slipped through Ghirapur with a series of sideways moves.

timeline.summary: Liliana persuades Chandra to celebrate her return while still looking for the renegade.
timeline.quote: Then I think it's high time we celebrated your grand return to your hometown.

timeline.summary: The hooded man hides his face and arm in the crowd to complete his mission unnoticed.
timeline.quote: He needed to complete his mission before anyone had a chance to notice him.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra's search turns into mingling with inventors and dancing.
timeline.quote: Chandra's and Liliana's search for the renegade had become a series of chats with renegade sympathizers

timeline.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
timeline.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

timeline.summary: When the soldier pulls out restraints, Chandra punches him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist arced around and collided with his jawbone in one fluid motion.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana flee out the back of the nightclub.
timeline.quote: Chandra hopped a guardrail and ducked through the back of the nightclub.

timeline.summary: The module reveals to the man the conversations and a location for the demonstration.
timeline.quote: As he walked, he willed it to activate

timeline.summary: Chandra shows Liliana a worn mosaic of her father Kiran and says her parents were killed when she was a child.
timeline.quote: They were killed when I was a child.

timeline.summary: Chandra blames a uniformed officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: My parents died because of him.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges Chandra to find Baral and burn him, and Chandra swears he will pay.
timeline.quote: I swear he's going to pay for what he did.

timeline.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
timeline.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana jump onto the Aradara dawn train to escape.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran and stepped up, putting her hand in the way as the doors tried to close.

timeline.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
timeline.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns open the train door and they leap off to reach the disruption.
timeline.quote: Chandra hot-punched the door handle.

timeline.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
timeline.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

timeline.summary: The man accosts an older woman, pointing a metallic claw hand at her.
timeline.quote: His right hand, emerging from his sleeve, was a metallic claw

timeline.summary: The woman with Chandra's auburn hair stuns Chandra, who is shocked.
timeline.quote: She had auburn hair like Chandra's, but darker

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the woman Renegade Prime and warns her spectacle will not matter to his Fair, but she vows to stop the Head Judge.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Liliana grabs the man and names him Tezzeret with disgust.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Chandra, gaping at the woman with hair like hers, speaks to her as her mother.
timeline.quote: gaping at the woman with the hair like hers

timeline.summary: Years later, Pia has rallied a contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether.
timeline.quote: Pia had rallied a growing contingent of inventors, tinkers, artists

timeline.summary: On a rooftop Pia coaches the inexperienced apprentice Tamni through repairing a thopter.
timeline.quote: You'll be fine, but we'll need to be fast.

timeline.summary: Venkat, a former Consulate commander, joins Pia disguised in a lieutenant's uniform.
timeline.quote: Once a high-ranking commander of the Consulate guard forces

timeline.summary: Pia rallies the renegades, listing grievances about the Consulate taking their aether, before the display.
timeline.quote: Let us be as proud, unafraid, unyielding as those who believe they can extinguish our spirits!

timeline.summary: The renegades launch nearly a hundred thopters that form a glittering column over the fairgrounds.
timeline.quote: The machines dove through the air to opposite ends of the plaza, nearly a hundred in number.

timeline.summary: The thopters change colors and form the leaking spire symbol over the Fair.
timeline.quote: As the metal of the thopters heated, their colors changed through yellows to greens to rich purples and blues

timeline.summary: The thopters release a pulse of aether that topples the Consulate automatons.
timeline.quote: The sudden rush of energy flooded into the identical automata, creating sparks of concentrated aether.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret, flanked by automatons and Dovin Baan, seizes Pia with his metal claw.
timeline.quote: The hand that gripped her arm was a massive claw of dark metal

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls Pia the Renegade Prime and she vows to stop him.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and names Tezzeret, and he names her Vess in return.
timeline.quote: A pale woman clad in dark flowing silks and a glinting golden headpiece appeared opposite the Head Judge.

timeline.summary: Pia sees Chandra, grown and unmistakable, and is flooded with memories.
timeline.quote: Older but unmistakable. Her little girl, now even taller than Kiran had been.

timeline.summary: Chandra charges the soldiers and burns a crowd of automatons.
timeline.quote: inundated a crowd of the machines with a generous bath of flames

timeline.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
timeline.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

timeline.summary: Nissa's vines topple guards moving on Chandra.
timeline.quote: Several of them toppled, feet tangled in a hissing whirl of flowered vines

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

timeline.summary: Soldiers manacle Pia and read out her crimes.
timeline.quote: you are hereby placed under the authority of the Consulate for the following crimes

timeline.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
timeline.quote: You forgot assault!

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat as the soldiers drag Pia away.
timeline.quote: They have her! You can't risk it now; we have to go!

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls Jace's scars when she thinks of Tezzeret and warns he is dangerous.
timeline.quote: Jace, his back stitched with ugly white scars from a manablade.

timeline.summary: Nissa angrily confronts Liliana for leaving without telling the others.
timeline.quote: Why did you leave without letting us know?

timeline.summary: Liliana cruelly tells Nissa that Chandra ran from her and came to Liliana.
timeline.quote: She ran from you

timeline.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
timeline.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Yahenni dresses for his party, knowing he has fifty-four days to live.
timeline.quote: I have fifty-four days left to live.

timeline.summary: Depala hints that Yahenni could extend his life by essence draining, and he refuses.
timeline.quote: I'm not willing to go those lengths, Depala.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
timeline.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri tells Yahenni that Pia Nalaar has been captured and asks what he knows.
timeline.quote: Pia Nalaar was captured, you know.

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps that Yahenni would help if it were his parent.
timeline.quote: If it was your parent you'd help us,

timeline.summary: A dying aetherborn is carried in on a chair to attend their penultimate party.
timeline.quote: It's my penultimate party!

timeline.summary: Yahenni takes Nissa to the roof and explains that aetherborn are the city's own natural beings.
timeline.quote: We are the city. I'm made of aether, and one day, I'll return to it.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that this world is structured and cyclical.
timeline.quote: This world is structured. Cyclical.

timeline.summary: A Consulate prison enforcer tries to force a bathroom door to seize a wanted convict.
timeline.quote: A wanted convict is currently barricaded behind that door.

timeline.summary: Yahenni offers Chandra and Nissa information in return for removing the enforcer and breaking the door.
timeline.quote: I'll give you the information you need if you'll help me.

timeline.summary: A potted plant coils around the enforcer's leg and he falls dazed.
timeline.quote: The potted plant by the door is inexplicably wrapped around the enforcer's leg

timeline.summary: Yahenni reads the enforcer's energy to learn Pia is held in Dhund prison.
timeline.quote: Dhund prison?

timeline.summary: Nissa carries the enforcer outside.
timeline.quote: easily hoists the man over her shoulders in a fireman's carry

timeline.summary: Chandra melts the lock of the bathroom door with a white-hot finger.
timeline.quote: quickly melts the locks with a white-hot finger to the metal

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Mrs. Pashiri leave at once to find Pia.
timeline.quote: We need to go now,

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds an escaped aetherborn convict dying in the bathroom with one minute left.
timeline.quote: I've got about a minute left,

timeline.summary: The dying aetherborn dies, their aether rising in vapor, after saying they had a good run.
timeline.quote: Their dermis crumbles and the contained aether escapes and rises in a gentle vapor to the ceiling.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds the dead aetherborn was jailed for petty theft and is enraged at the Consulate.
timeline.quote: They shouldn't have been sent to prison in the first place.

timeline.summary: Yahenni considers hunting down the Consulate with essence draining but decides the time will come later.
timeline.quote: No. The time will come for that.

timeline.summary: Yahenni announces the party of a lifetime after the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: I'm hosting the party of a lifetime here after the conclusion of the Inventors' Fair.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
timeline.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

timeline.summary: On a skiff across the river, Nissa thinks of Ashaya and of her place in the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She thought of Ashaya then, her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

timeline.summary: Ajani wears mechanical gauntlets made for him by Glint-Sleeves at Grandmother Pashiri's request while infiltrating Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: They'd been crafted by the Glint-Sleeves, a group that specialized in such bodily attachments.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Grandmother Pashiri's building surrounded by Consulate inspectors.
timeline.quote: Grandmother's building was surrounded.

timeline.summary: Ajani sneaks into her ransacked home and knocks two inspectors' heads together.
timeline.quote: His metal-shrouded hands caught and knocked their heads together.

timeline.summary: Ajani pins the supervisor to a wall and demands to know where Grandmother Pashiri is.
timeline.quote: Where is Grandmother Pashiri?

timeline.summary: The supervisor says she is in custody, trapped as a renegade, and Ajani knocks him out, saying he no longer kills.
timeline.quote: I don't kill.

timeline.summary: Ajani follows Grandmother's attar scent across the city like a tracker.
timeline.quote: It was a different kind of jungle, but he was a tracker.

timeline.summary: A blade at his back reveals Shadowblayde, who confirms he is a renegade ally with a secret phrase.
timeline.quote: A slight pressure settled against the back of his cloak, just hard enough for him to know it as the point of a blade.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde says she came looking for Renegade Prime and fears the Consuls took them, and offers to take Ajani to a renegade safe house.
timeline.quote: I came here looking for Renegade Prime. She was overdue.

timeline.summary: At the safe house Tamni tells Ajani that Consulate men with a false-armed leader arrested Pia and that Mrs. Pashiri led two women toward Kujar.
timeline.quote: when I got there, the Consulate had her surrounded

timeline.summary: Ajani counsels Tamni that charging rashly into battle is foolishness.
timeline.quote: To charge rashly into battle, unprepared, is not courage.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde has Dayal gather renegade lifecrafters with mechanical creatures to search for Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Dayal! Gather the troops.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains that thousands of lifecrafted creatures across Ghirapur can search faster than one giant.
timeline.quote: But there's thousands of little creations like ours in Ghirapur.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde learns through Mihir's bird that Pashiri was spotted at the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Pashiri was spotted twenty minutes ago.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
timeline.quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Shadowblayde to prepare a fast, secret escape route while he goes in alone.
timeline.quote: Can you find us a means of escape? Something fast. Secret.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde gives Ajani a mechanical bird to lead him to a Dhund entrance.
timeline.quote: When you're close to a Dhund entrance, he'll fly to it.

timeline.summary: Ajani shows his face to Shadowblayde, who tells him her real name, Vatti.
timeline.quote: That's my mundane name. Vatti.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

timeline.summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
timeline.quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

timeline.summary: Chandra decides to face Tezzeret's challenge despite the risk of another trap.
timeline.quote: He's calling me out,

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

timeline.summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
timeline.quote: What's a Gatewatch?

timeline.summary: A thopter photographs the group and delivers the images to Consul Kambal aboard the Skysovereign.
timeline.quote: one that showed the target, Nalaar, daughter of Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Kambal tells the courier to inform Inspector Baan that the bait is set and the confiscation can be prepared.
timeline.quote: Alert Inspector Baan. The bait is set. Prepare the confiscation.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
timeline.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

timeline.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
timeline.quote: He's building something

timeline.summary: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers seize inventions across the fairgrounds, provoking panic and anger among the inventors.
timeline.quote: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers were seizing inventions in their characteristically clumsy fashion

timeline.summary: Baan advises an enforcer how to disable a lifecraft elephant by cutting its exposed cable.
timeline.quote: All that is required is to sever the cable, and the entire automaton will collapse.

timeline.summary: Baan orders the elven lifecrafter taken into custody for the disturbance.
timeline.quote: Take the elf into custody to answer for this disturbance.

timeline.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
timeline.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

timeline.summary: Baan soothes an angry inventor whose thopter fabricator is being confiscated, assuring him the Consulate is grateful.
timeline.quote: The Consulate is grateful.

timeline.summary: Baan reaches the storage facility where scientists catalog the confiscated inventions, which he now oversees.
timeline.quote: Top scientists and inventors from every Consulate inquirium in the city had been sent here

timeline.summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.
timeline.quote: Increased Bastion presence. Curfews, perhaps.

timeline.summary: The Consulate announces the Inventors' Fair, to be held for a month across downtown Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: For a full month, the fairgrounds will span the whole of downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh.

timeline.summary: Head Judge Tezzeret calls for theoretical breakthroughs in the Aether Science category.
timeline.quote: Head Judge Tezzeret himself has put out the call for any and all theoretical breakthroughs

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

timeline.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
timeline.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

timeline.summary: A thopter signals Gideon that Pia has news, and he returns to Yahenni's penthouse.
timeline.quote: Gideon sighed. Pia had news.

timeline.summary: Rashmi leaps out of the window on a harness cable and escapes Tezzeret above Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: she sprinted to the gaping hole and leapt out into the swirling aether beyond.

timeline.summary: Saheeli rescues Rashmi in her construct and tells her Mitul is safe.
timeline.quote: "He's safe," Saheeli said.

timeline.summary: Rashmi realizes Saheeli knew the transporter's implications and senses the planeswalker nature in her; Saheeli welcomes her to the renegade movement.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend. I have much to tell you."

timeline.summary: Kari and Jace use Jace's illusions to pose as a Consulate vessel and steal canisters of aether from a Consulate collecting ship.
timeline.quote: smuggling canisters of their inventory onto her ship under the approving gaze of Consulate stooges

timeline.summary: Kari bluffs a suspicious Consulate lieutenant who doubts her age, with Ragavan's screech helping.
timeline.quote: Perhaps there's a reason you're still a lieutenant. Think on that.

timeline.summary: Depala dives the Dragon's Smile into the Consulate blockade, scattering the formation, and the raiders deploy.
timeline.quote: Dragon's Smile soared between the first of the Consulate ships and through the gap in the blockade.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures an illusory fleet from Kari's memories of her destroyed ships, which fills the sky.
timeline.quote: Her fleet had returned to her, and they were assembling to fill the space above a plaza

timeline.summary: The officer fires a net; Ragavan takes it for Kari and is carried off, and Kari chases the officer.
timeline.quote: In the next heartbeat, the officer was off—and with her, the net containing Kari's prince.

timeline.summary: Kari wrecks the officer's propeller with her sword and rescues Ragavan.
timeline.quote: Kari just winked at the officer, and shoved her sword into the spinning action of one of the four propellers

timeline.summary: The Skysovereign engages the illusory fleet; its lightning cannon blinds Depala, and Jace links her to his mind so she can see.
timeline.quote: So instead, he returned a favor.

timeline.summary: Kari meets skywhales in an aether eddy and decides to use the aether as bait.
timeline.quote: But then she stopped. And all at once, she saw it. Opportunity.

timeline.summary: Kari smashes jettisoned aether canisters, a skywhale rams the Skysovereign, and the flagship drifts to the ground.
timeline.quote: the whole thing listed to one side and drifted slowly to the ground.

timeline.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
timeline.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

timeline.summary: The ground team fights through automata and peacewalkers around the turret; Shadowblayde is caught in a peacewalker's treads.
timeline.quote: She lost her footing and fell sideways, dragged toward the spikes as she struggled to release herself.

timeline.summary: Ajani frees Shadowblayde from the treads and Nissa lifts the peacewalker to save them.
timeline.quote: Nissa stood under the chassis, her arms holding up the great mechanical beast

timeline.summary: The renegades release dozens of gremlins that devour the turret's aether and disable it.
timeline.quote: Torn open and drained, the turret went dark and the cannon sagged, aetherless and useless.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives in the war-torn streets of Ghirapur, recalling Caligo Forest, resolved to kill Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had to die.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises a dead renegade as a zombie bodyguard.
timeline.quote: She waved a hand in its direction, and a new zombie struggled to its feet.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur celebrates a new Consulate leadership that includes Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: One that included even "Renegade Prime" herself, Pia Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra repair the mosaic of Kiran; Chandra offers to stay, but Pia insists she go and return, revealing she made shrines to both Chandra and Kiran.
timeline.quote: We can stop being a family of leaving, and become a family of arriving.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells her mother she is going to Amonkhet and says goodbye.
timeline.quote: "To Amonkhet. Someplace I've never been."

timeline.summary: In meditation Nissa witnesses a new aetherborn form from aether and guides them to the other aetherborn, hearing an echo of Yahenni.
timeline.quote: The aetherborn looked at their hands, then at Nissa's flowers.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

timeline.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

timeline.summary: Baral leads Chandra through old stone streets toward a trap.
timeline.quote: "All that time your mother suffered . Thinking you were dead ."

timeline.summary: Chandra turns the thorn wall into a fire and injures her arm; Nissa's vines and elemental destroy Baral's thopters.
timeline.quote: A trio of vines leapt up from the neighboring streets, raining debris.

timeline.summary: Baral and Baan escape the failed trap in a thopter, and the Consulate's next phase begins.
timeline.quote: High above them, the black specks of thopters lifted from the decks of Skysovereign .

timeline.summary: Gideon is stomped by a Gearhulk, survives, and climbs it to survey the battle.
timeline.quote: "It's all right," he called, with forced cheer. "I'm indestructible."

timeline.summary: Liliana rots a living-wood Gearhulk to pieces.
timeline.quote: She snapped her fingers, and the Gearhulk fell to pieces at her feet.

timeline.summary: Gideon drops into a Gearhulk's gears and wrecks it from inside; Shadowblayde's crew rescues him.
timeline.quote: He looked into the gap between the armor, took a few rapid breaths, and dropped into the gears.

timeline.summary: Gideon sees Consulate thopters approaching the Hub and rushes back.
timeline.quote: "Get back to the Hub!" he shouted, breaking into a run.

timeline.summary: Baral confronts Chandra and Nissa on a rooftop; Nissa fights his automatons with a sword and Baral nearly kills Chandra with his blade.
timeline.quote: The blade falls.

timeline.summary: Baral claims he killed Kiran Nalaar and Chandra's auntie and prepares to kill Chandra; Chandra gathers superheated fire, ready to release it.
timeline.quote: "I killed your daddy, renegade," he says.

timeline.summary: Nissa embraces Chandra and talks her down from detonating, guiding her to put out the fire through a memory of floating in a quarry.
timeline.quote: "Don't leave us," Nissa says, softly. "You're loved."

timeline.summary: Nissa's elemental batters Baral, and the women escape.
timeline.quote: A tree slammed into him from the left.

timeline.summary: Baan arrests the injured Baral for murder, attempted murder, extrajudicial incarceration and falsifying records.
timeline.quote: Chief Inspector Dhiren Baral, I charge you with one count of murder

timeline.summary: Baan reports the Hub regained and leaves Baral under arrest.
timeline.quote: The Aether Hub has been regained.

timeline.summary: Huatli arrives in a bustling inventors' city on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: She emerged into a city unlike any she had seen before.

timeline.summary: Huatli watches an aetherborn inventor unveil the aether regulator.
timeline.quote: It is a medical device that will ease uncomfortable symptoms of dissipation

timeline.summary: Saheeli, a fellow planeswalker, pulls Huatli aside and introduces herself.
timeline.quote: My name is Saheeli.

timeline.summary: Saheeli names the plane Kaladesh and the city Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: This plane is Kaladesh, and this city is Ghirapur.

timeline.summary: Saheeli takes Huatli to her workshop to make a dinosaur.
timeline.quote: We are going back to my workshop right now so you can describe them to me.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Saheeli wakes tied to a chair in a room of stolen art as Gonti, who knows everything about her family, addresses her.
timeline.quote: she woke up tied to a chair in this place.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti reveals their cracked-stone chest and failing aether heart and demands Saheeli repair it.
timeline.quote: It has begun to fail.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti threatens to have Saheeli's family executed, starting with her mother, and shows her mother's bracelet.
timeline.quote: If I don't send word in the allotted time, their instructions are to execute everyone.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Saheeli repairs Gonti's cracked silver filament, learning Gonti is immortal, and Gonti reveals the threat was a test of faith.
timeline.quote: A small fracture in the filament had developed over time

timeline.summary: Pia recalls Saheeli's warning of an invasion and the Phyrexian eye symbol appearing everywhere.
timeline.quote: We have to be ready for an invasion,

timeline.summary: Pia and Saheeli address the consulate and prepare Ghirapur, evacuating citizens and arming skyships.
timeline.quote: If Pia allocated the resources to fight, then fight they would.

timeline.summary: The portals open and the invasion spines descend onto Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: the great spines of invasion descended from the holes they tore in reality

timeline.summary: A branch wraps around Ghirapur's flagship and destroys it.
timeline.quote: She watches as the branch wraps around the ship

timeline.summary: Saheeli's Operation Golden Scales deploys bronze lizards that clash with Phyrexian soldiers, and she rescues Pia.
timeline.quote: Deployment chambers spring up from hatches all along the street

timeline.summary: Saheeli evades telling Pia what happened to Chandra.
timeline.quote: Pia's been around politicians long enough to know when she isn't getting the whole story.

timeline.summary: Baji offers his skimmer and Pia boards it, but a Phyrexian quill kills him and the skimmer plummets with Pia at the controls.
timeline.quote: a javelin punches through the window and impales him through the chest to his seat

timeline.summary: Ishikari faces the invasion of Ghirapur as warships are fired upon, resolved to make her death count.
timeline.quote: As the cannons of Ghirapur fire upon the toothy warships of the invaders

timeline.summary: Ishikari climbs her workshop tower, recalling how Rashmi's Planar Bridge revealed other worlds.
timeline.quote: Up the stairs she goes.

timeline.summary: Ishikari recalls her first dream of Ghirapur under attack and the hope she could carve from it.
timeline.quote: Shortly after that , Ishikari had the first dream.

timeline.summary: On the tower top, Ishikari sees planar windows tearing open in the sky.
timeline.quote: The yawning pits across the sky, the glimpses into worlds she could only imagine.

timeline.summary: Ishikari presents her improvised net machine, built in defiance of the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Crafted from whatever she could get her hands on in defiance of the Consulate and good sense alike

timeline.summary: Ishikari realizes the incomplete machine, which needs a mage's power, may kill her.
timeline.quote: to activate it may kill her

timeline.summary: Ishikari pulls the lever and her consciousness joins the Blind Eternities, attaining the unattainable.
timeline.quote: Ishikari pulls the lever—and in that moment, as her consciousness briefly becomes one with the Blind Eternities—she really does attain the unattainable.

timeline.summary: Sita, the underground racing queen Spitfire, struggles over the estate wall and sneaks home.
timeline.quote: Ghirapur's current queen of underground racing, the mysterious and tough and seemingly unbeatable Spitfire, is having some trouble climbing the wall

timeline.summary: Sita hides her racing suit and changes into the dress her father expects.
timeline.quote: She hides her racing suit in her nightstand and hurries to change into the dress he expects of her.

timeline.summary: Mohar, who has not shed his consul's trappings, doles out strict expectations to Sita.
timeline.quote: Mohar Varma, Sita's father, has not yet shed the stations and signifiers of his former office

timeline.summary: Sita corrects her father that the plane is now called Avishkar and argues about tradition.
timeline.quote: It's Avishkar now

timeline.summary: A radio report announces the Grand Prix winner will claim the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: The winner of the Ghirapur Grand Prix gets to claim this once-in-a-lifetime chance at ultimate power and freedom.

timeline.summary: Mohar hurls the radio across the room at the mention of Gonti.
timeline.quote: The moment Gonti's name is announced on the radio, Mohar hurls it across the room.

timeline.summary: Mohar says Sita must be married advantageously, and then notices aether fumes on her.
timeline.quote: We must find you an advantageous marriage somewhere

timeline.summary: Sita puts on her Spitfire mask.
timeline.quote: Sita puts on the mask.

timeline.summary: Spitfire arrives at the Aether Rangers' garage where screens show Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar's face is smiling across all their screens.

timeline.summary: Pia Nalaar reveals she has upgraded Spitfire's racer with advanced aether systems.
timeline.quote: A ten-cylinder aether inverter system, two separate cyclonic mitigators

timeline.summary: Chandra is mobbed by reporters over tea and tries to joke with them.
timeline.quote: Chandra picks up her teacup in one hand and waves with the other.

timeline.summary: Chandra reveals that her only reason to race is to put a smile on Nissa's face.
timeline.quote: The only reason she's doing any of this is to put a smile on that face.

timeline.summary: Chandra says she wishes her mother the best as long as it is second place.
timeline.quote: I wish her all the best, as long as 'the best' is second place.

timeline.summary: Winter studies Chandra on a screen while ghouls work on his racer and a demon stares at him.
timeline.quote: He just needs to study her—her and all the other racers.

timeline.summary: A demon tells Winter to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House.
timeline.quote: Bring us the Aetherspark, and you're free. Fail, and you belong to the House.

timeline.summary: Sita arranges a cover story to leave her father's house for the race.
timeline.quote: If her father is to believe that she's needed elsewhere, he must see that she is needed elsewhere.

timeline.summary: Caradora and Lagorin are interviewed by Vin on screen.
timeline.quote: Lagorin is just as much a leader of our team as I am.

timeline.summary: Lalan arrives and pretends Sita has an internship at her atelier.
timeline.quote: I just thought I'd swing by to pick up Sita for her internship.

timeline.summary: Mohar approves the internship and embraces Sita.
timeline.quote: When you return, we'll stop by your mother's memorial and show her your creations.

timeline.summary: Spitfire passes Far Fortune and a shark-man chordatan in the pits.
timeline.quote: Of all the other racers, Fortune is the only one that really intimidates Spitfire.

timeline.summary: Pia gives Spitfire a new aether-powered racing suit.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, she finds a new racing suit.

timeline.summary: Pia explains the suit's aether capsules grant two seconds of enhanced speed.
timeline.quote: With one of those capsules in your system, you'll be quicker than the gods for about two seconds.

timeline.summary: Pia admits the suit was sized for someone else, implying Chandra.
timeline.quote: It's because I'm taller than her, isn't it?

timeline.summary: Chandra hears a caged creature crying and finds it among Winter's vehicles and ghouls.
timeline.quote: The cage itself is so small that the creature is forced to stand on its hind legs at all times.

timeline.summary: Winter warns Chandra off, threatening she will end up last with six pallbearers.
timeline.quote: Chronic-hero syndrome gets you last place and six pallbearers.

timeline.summary: Chandra heats and bends the cage bars to give the creature a perch.
timeline.quote: She pulls two of the bars apart wide enough to make a little perch for the creature.

timeline.summary: Suraj recalls building the platform and takes his VIP seat.
timeline.quote: The platform Suraj is standing on is one he oversaw himself.

timeline.summary: Night Minister Gonti addresses the crowd as grand marshal.
timeline.quote: We thank all of you for attending.

timeline.summary: Suraj reveals Gonti approved a cheaper copper alloy for the platforms instead of steel.
timeline.quote: a cheaper, more quickly made copper alloy instead of steel

timeline.summary: Gonti fires the signal flare to start the Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Gonti fires the flare.

timeline.summary: The racers surge off the line while Chandra starts in last place.
timeline.quote: With a speed before now unknown to creation, the racers streak out past the starting gates.

timeline.summary: The spectator platform begins to topple under the cheering crowd.
timeline.quote: The platform is going to fall over.

timeline.summary: An Endrider throws a hooked chain at Spitfire's ride, and she narrowly evades it.
timeline.quote: The fierce young vagabond throws a hooked chain toward Spitfire's ride.

timeline.summary: A zombified Amonkheti beast tramples an Endrider's chain and crushes his leg.
timeline.quote: an Amonkheti beast trample over the chain binding the Endrider to the pole

timeline.summary: Spitfire uses an aether canister to slow time for herself.
timeline.quote: Spitfire twists the canister and enters the infinite.

timeline.summary: Spitfire uses auxiliary thrusters to leap past a spectral arm of the Speed Demons.
timeline.quote: Flipping a switch on the steering wheel activates the auxiliary thrusters.

timeline.summary: Spitfire shoots through the gap in the collapsing platform.
timeline.quote: Spitfire shoots through it.

timeline.summary: Mohar sees the race footage on every channel and hears a howl in his halls.
timeline.quote: Every single channel is playing it on loop it seems.

timeline.summary: A green-skinned woman with tendril hair and a blue-cloaked man paralyze Mohar in his own home.
timeline.quote: it is a woman he sees—one with green skin and serpentine tendrils for hair.

timeline.summary: The intruders offer Mohar the power to undo the revolution and restore the old order.
timeline.quote: Would you like to make that dream a reality?

timeline.summary: Spitfire races through the Omenpath into Ghirapur, leading the field to the finish.
timeline.quote: As her ride howls through the Omenpath, there is nothing to hamper her.

timeline.summary: Spitfire and Winter go chassis to chassis near the finish.
timeline.quote: The Aether Ranger's front bumper scrapes against the Speed Demon's driver-side door.

timeline.summary: Winter fires blue flame at Spitfire and bursts into flame.
timeline.quote: Winter shoots a gout of blue flame at her.

timeline.summary: A golden filigree safety wall shoots up in the track, ahead of the finish line.
timeline.quote: Shooting up in the middle of the track is an intricate wall of golden filigree

timeline.summary: Spitfire crashes into the wall, knocked dazed.
timeline.quote: Stars explode across the back of her eyes

timeline.summary: Half of Spitfire's mask falls into her lap, revealing her to guards as Sita.
timeline.quote: For there in her lap is half of Spitfire's mask.

timeline.summary: Guards drag her before her father, who demands to know the meaning of this.
timeline.quote: Sita! Are you all right? What is the meaning of this? You could have been killed out there!

timeline.summary: Mohar orders his daughter taken to a doctor and tells his men to keep it secret.
timeline.quote: Tell no one of this.

timeline.summary: Vraska pulls Winter from the Speed Demons' wreck.
timeline.quote: Vraska tears Winter from the wreckage.

timeline.summary: Jace compels Winter to go limp and searches his mind for Loot.
timeline.quote: With another wave of his hand, Jace compels him to go limp.

timeline.summary: Vraska says they promised to keep Loot safe.
timeline.quote: We promised to keep him safe.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to take Winter prisoner as a loose end.
timeline.quote: I think we need to take him prisoner.

timeline.summary: Falling toward Ghirapur, Chandra sees the crowd panicking instead of celebrating.
timeline.quote: But as she realizes that the masses below are not celebrating but panicking, a different feeling takes hold.

timeline.summary: Pia identifies the guards below as Consulate thugs.
timeline.quote: From the colors, those are Consulate thugs

timeline.summary: Chandra scorches a roof to slow the falling car, then jumps clear.
timeline.quote: She aims for a sturdy-looking roof instead, then scorches the side of the same building all the way down to try and slow them down.

timeline.summary: Chandra lands in a cart of racing-team plush toys.
timeline.quote: She lands in a cart of plush toys themed after each of the racing teams.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees Jace flanked by the Consulate's goons, with Vraska at his side.
timeline.quote: Her eyes find him where she least expected him: flanked on either side by the Consulate's powerfully muscled goons.

timeline.summary: Jace raises a hand and Loot's eyes go blank.
timeline.quote: Jace raises a hand, and the little guy's eyes go blank.

timeline.summary: A storm and a screeching dragon roar over Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: Worse is the horrible, screeching roar of what can only be a dragon.

timeline.summary: The city's defenses open fire at the dragon.
timeline.quote: Bolts of aether fire at the massive silhouette soaring above the skies of Ghirapur.

timeline.summary: The dragon melts a roof cannon.
timeline.quote: Its blazing breath melts one of the roof-mounted defense cannons to little more than slag.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to hand Loot over to Jace.
timeline.quote: I told Loot I would look after him,

timeline.summary: Jace sends armored guards to attack Chandra.
timeline.quote: A wave of his hands sends the armored toughs charging straight at her.

timeline.summary: Chandra's fireball passes through an illusion of Jace.
timeline.quote: An illusion. Of course.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees that the golden wall trapped racers including the Aether Rangers.
timeline.quote: The Aether Rangers aren't the only ones who got caught in the trap, either.

timeline.summary: Jace casts a spell of misty white that turns the wrecked racers' eyes white and makes them attack Chandra.
timeline.quote: Spirals of magic flash around Jace; a net of misty white surrounds the racers still pulling themselves from the wrecks.

timeline.summary: Racers charge Chandra as one, including Captain Howler and Redshift.
timeline.quote: As one, they charge.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders her group to apprehend Chandra hidden in a wreck.
timeline.quote: The pyromancer's in there. Apprehend her.

timeline.summary: Guarded by her father, Sita plans to use her last aether canister to cross the finish line.
timeline.quote: Most important of all, she still has one canister left.

timeline.summary: Guards seize Pia and put a blade to her throat as Chandra is dragged away.
timeline.quote: The guards grab Pia by the hair, put a blade to her throat

timeline.summary: Sita injects aether instead of racing to the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: Canister meets port; aether meets bloodstream.

timeline.summary: Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia.
timeline.quote: Sita throws off the hands keeping her in place, rushes past her hapless father, and dives straight for Pia Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Pia and Sita fight together as Team Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Engine, wheels, and transmission. Chandra, Pia, and Sita.

timeline.summary: Daretti sends drones to scout and Loot wakes from Jace's control.
timeline.quote: Even Loot's woken up

timeline.summary: Vin broadcasts live from behind a statue as the fight rages.
timeline.quote: It's your in- vin -cible pal Vin, reporting live from the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

timeline.summary: Jace unleashes a punishing mind attack on Chandra and the others.
timeline.quote: Whatever magic Jace is using against her is nasty stuff

timeline.summary: Jace picks up the little creature from Chandra's crumpled form.
timeline.quote: He watches as Jace picks up something from Chandra's crumpled form—a little creature of some kind.

timeline.summary: An archangel shields Vin from the dragon's fire.
timeline.quote: Hovering before Vin is an angel.

timeline.summary: Nissa arrives riding vines toward the stadium to reach Chandra.
timeline.quote: Nissa surfs through the streets toward the Ghirapur Stadium.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees Elspeth fighting the dragon.
timeline.quote: Elspeth's got the dragon handled.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra, Pia and Sita collapsed.
timeline.quote: Crumpled before the remnants of a great ship: Chandra, Pia, and that other girl she'd seen on the broadcast.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees Jace scoop up the limp creature.
timeline.quote: She turns to see Jace scooping up a limp, small creature.

timeline.summary: Jace calls Vraska away, leaving with Loot.
timeline.quote: We're leaving, Vraska,

timeline.summary: Nissa begs them to stay but a magical fog covers their escape.
timeline.quote: But by then, a haze of magical fog overtakes the clearing, and Nissa knows it's no use.

timeline.summary: Winter, with a broken leg, tries to cross the undefended finish line on foot.
timeline.quote: The rules don't say anything about crossing the finish line on foot.

timeline.summary: Basri shields civilians with sand that turns to glass in the dragon's heat.
timeline.quote: Basri Ket conjured waves of sand to shield the fleeing civilians

timeline.summary: Zahur and Basri realize they have crossed the finish line first, and Zahur declares the Aetherspark's blessing.
timeline.quote: For life, for death, for Amonkhet.

timeline.summary: A door appears and Winter is dragged back to hell as the Amonkheti win.
timeline.quote: But they will make no mention of the man so close to victory dragged with awful finality back to hell.

timeline.summary: The Champions receive the Aetherspark together as a team.
timeline.quote: When they receive the Aetherspark, it is as a team—no one person's hand touches it before any other.

relations.quote: What used to be the best night district in the city is boarded up

relations.note: A garden in the city near Aradara Station.
relations.quote: The Statuary Garden is a massive arboretum near Aradara Station.
sucked papers and tools out into the sky high above Ghirapur.

relations.note: The Hub is Ghirapur's beating heart.
relations.quote: An elf had once described the Aether Hub to him as Ghirapur's beating heart.
their reign over Ghirapur's underworld had lasted well longer than an aetherborn's lifespan

The city of Kaladesh under Consulate curfew.
A gleaming city of Kaladesh under crackdown.
The city of Kaladesh over which Rashmi leaps from the Spire.

The city under blockade.

The city on Kaladesh from which they planeswalk.
The city on Kaladesh in civil war.

The Kaladeshi city that holds the aetherflux reservoir and is evacuated and defended.
